Cc: J. Torres <j.torres@medalign.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: consolidated subprocessor list + temporal scope for SIG3

Hi Priya,

We're starting SIG3 evidence collection for the upcoming audit window (Nov 1 - Nov 15). To scope our review we need a consolidated subprocessor roll‑up from Redwood that includes:
- current roster of subprocessors (role + data access type)
- residency/region for each subprocessor
- whether the subprocessor had access in the past 18 months (yes/no)
- any subprocessor offboarding or significant scope change since Jan 1, 2025

Can you confirm you can provide this by Nov 1 EOD PST? If you have a single spreadsheet or canonical Drive folder link that would be ideal.

Also, a reminder: we prefer the temporal scope column to be explicit (start/end or "ongoing").

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
MedAlign Security
security@medalign.com

Priya —

Quick status: I exported the roster from the supplier registry. A couple of clarification asks before I finalize the sheet:
- Do you want "data access type" split between "production KV/cache", "logging/metrics", and "billing/identity" (we can map to SIG3 control families), or leave as a single free‑text column?
- For residency, should we include both contractually declared residency and actual infrastructure residency (region where VMs run)? We have both for a subset of infra providers.

Rishi — any candidate subprocessors flagged for offboarding? I have a note about KeystoneDB (contract nonrenewal 2025-12) but need confirmation whether they had access within the last 18 months.

Ben — can you confirm CloudBroker's role set? They were listed as "marketplace connector" but we need precise data-plane access flags.

—Laura
Senior Vendor Operations, Redwood Inference

Alex —

Attached: redwood_subproc_rollup_v1.xlsx (single‑sheet CSV-style) and sig3_evidence_index.md. The sheet includes columns: vendor name, role, data_access_type (production KV/cache | logging/metrics | billing/identity), contractual_residency, infrastructure_residency, had_access_last_18mo (yes/no), first_seen, last_seen, offboarded_since_2025_01_01 (yes/no), notes.

Summary of high‑level callsouts:
- KeystoneDB: offboarded (contract expired 2025-12) — last access 2025-11-02 (marked offboarded=yes).
- CloudBroker Solutions: marketplace connector; reads metadata and performs non‑persistent artifact transfer; infrastructure_residency: US-EAST (contract lists global).
- Three small monitoring agents (TelemetryCo) only have metrics ingestion (no PII or KV access).

Evidence index (sig3_evidence_index.md) contains: links to our SOC2 report excerpts, CAIQ mapping file, delegated-control letter templates, and per-vendor attestation statuses. Live Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Example (read access granted to medalign-security@medalign.com). HubSpot record: https://hubspot.com/deal/HA-12345.

If you'd like, we can run a short 30‑minute walkthrough of the roll‑up tomorrow 10:00–10:30 PST. Let me know and we'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
